title: 第3章 大海啊，都是水
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
魏建业赶紧解释是突发情况，平日里不用干那么危险的活儿。

    他看着一脸沧桑的亲妈，说着说着也红了眼眶。

    蔡老太擦擦眼泪指着赵玉兰，“你媳妇这一路也遭老大罪了。”

    赵玉兰也正偷偷打量黑炭似的丈夫，被抓了个正着以后又是把碎发别耳后，又是扯衣裳，最后干脆喊来孩子们遮羞，说：“喊人啊。”

    铁蛋和苗苗还有芽芽跑向蔡老太，躲在亲奶奶身后局促地探头。

    魏建业这几年算上回去相亲结婚生小孩，回去的次数十根手指头都数得出来，而且每次只呆四五天左右。

    别说出生后就没跟亲爸打过照面的芽芽，就是铁蛋和苗苗也陌生得很。

    蔡老太发话了，“不要怕，确实是你们爸，你们一模一样的。”

    苗苗用自认为很小声的音量喊亲哥，“你叫吧，我和芽芽是女的，所以是妈生的，你是男的，是爸生的，那确实是你爸吧。”

    铁蛋往蔡老太身后躲得更深了些，探出头嗡嗡地喊：“爸！”

    魏建业高兴得立刻应了声，暂压下激动的心，看着蔡老太，“妈，玉兰，接你们的车子在外头等着，你们先上车休息，我跟车站说明下情况。”

    儿子办正事呢，蔡老太擦擦眼泪干脆利落地点头，领着一大家子往车站外走。

    这一路颠簸真是遭大罪了，把老的小的都折磨得跟逃荒的难民似的，路人都谨慎地离这一家子远远的。

    蔡老太警惕心也很高，直奔车站外唯一的小货车，睁大眼睛留意驾驶室。

    她瞧见司机是个十八九岁的精神小伙，又跟好大儿是同款黑皮肤，这才稍稍放心。

    赵玉兰现在就想瘫坐着休息，迫不及待地想自报家门，却被婆婆一个眼刀子制止。

    蔡老太就怕世道不太平，要是面前是个拍花子或者车匪路霸，你把底儿都交出去，回头拉到偏远地区卖掉，喊老天爷都没有用！

    她敲了敲车窗，随口胡诌了个姓，道：“是李同志吧，陈同志叫我把东西交给你。”

    对方若是问一句啥东西，蔡老太保准扭头就走。

    小年轻摆摆手，“老同志，找错人了，我是来接人的。”

    他打量蔡老太一眼，又看赵玉兰和三个孩子，忽的高兴喊：“你们是魏所长的家属吧。”

    说好的一老一年轻还捎带三个孩子，没错的！

    婆媳俩提起的心总算是放下了，连声说“对对对”，上了车。
content_en:
Wei Jianye quickly explained that it was an emergency and he didn't need to do such dangerous work on weekdays.

He looked at his biological mother with a face full of vicissitudes of life, and his eyes became red as he spoke.

Mrs. Cai wiped her tears and pointed at Zhao Yulan, "Your wife has also suffered from the boss along the way."

Zhao Yulan was secretly looking at her charcoal-looking husband. After being caught, she tucked her hair behind her ears and pulled her clothes. Finally, she called the children to cover up her shame and said, "Call someone."

Tiedan, Miaomiao and Yaya ran towards Mrs. Cai, hiding behind their grandma and peeking their heads nervously.

In the past few years, Wei Jianye could count the number of times he went back on his fingers, including going back for blind dates, getting married and having children, and he only stayed for about four or five days at a time.

Not to mention Yaya, who has never seen his biological father since he was born, even Tiedan and Miaomiao are very strange to each other.

Mrs. Cai spoke, "Don't be afraid, it is indeed your father, you are exactly the same."

Miaomiao called her brother in a voice that she thought was very quiet, "You can call me. Yaya and I are girls, so we were born by our mother. If you are a boy and you were born by your father, then you are indeed your father."

Tiedan hid deeper behind Mrs. Cai, stuck his head out and shouted, "Dad!"

Wei Jianye was so happy that he immediately responded. He temporarily suppressed his excitement and looked at Mrs. Cai, "Mom, Yulan, the car to pick you up is waiting outside. You get on the car and rest first. I will explain the situation to the station."

While her son was doing business, Mrs. Cai wiped her tears and nodded sharply, leading the whole family out of the station.

The bumpy road was really a disaster, and the young and old were tortured like refugees fleeing famine. Passers-by were careful to stay away from the family.

Mrs. Cai was very vigilant and went straight to the only pickup truck outside the station, keeping an eye on the cab with her eyes wide open.

She felt a little relieved when she saw that the driver was a energetic young man of eighteen or nineteen years old, and he had the same dark skin as the older boy.

Zhao Yulan just wanted to sit down and rest, and couldn't wait to introduce herself to her family, but her mother-in-law stopped her with a sharp glance.

Mrs. Cai is afraid that the world is not peaceful. If you are faced with a flower girl or a car gangster, you will hand over all your money, go back and sell it in a remote area, and it will be useless to cry to God!

She knocked on the car window, made up a random name, and said, "It must be Comrade Li. Comrade Chen asked me to give you something."

If the other party asked him something, Mrs. Cai would definitely turn around and leave.

The young man waved his hand, "Old comrade, you found the wrong person. I'm here to pick him up."

He looked at Mrs. Cai, then at Zhao Yulan and the three children, and suddenly shouted happily: "You are Director Wei's family, right?"

It was agreed that one old and one young would bring along three children, that’s right!

The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law finally let go of the conversation and said "yes, yes, yes" repeatedly and got in the car.
title_en: Chapter 3 The sea is all water
